column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Tangut Component Data
#   Tangut component (radical) metadata for each of the 491 Tangut radicals
#   1. codepoint        - Unicode codepoint in U+XXXXX format
#   2. stroke_count     - Stroke count of the radical
#   4. char_count       - Number of characters using this radical
#   5. first_character  - Codepoint of first character with this radical (hex)
#   6. extra_count      - Extra stroke count used for lookup
